FROM supplier

      AND li.l_shipdate < '1996-04-01'

SELECT s_suppkey, s_name, COUNT(*) AS line_count
FROM supplier
JOIN partsupp ON s_suppkey = ps_suppkey
JOIN lineitem ON l_suppkey = ps_suppkey
JOIN orders ON l_orderkey = o_orderkey
JOIN customer ON o_custkey = c_custkey
JOIN nation ON c_nationkey = n_nationkey
WHERE o_orderdate >= '1995-01-01' AND o_orderdate < '1996-01-01'
GROUP BY s_suppkey, s_name
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n_nationkey) = (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT n_nationkey) FROM nation)
ORDER BY s_name
